<thought>To retrieve the template that generates the given precursors, I will search the template catalog using the product SMILES and a single functional group that is definitely formed in the Still‑Gennari reaction: a carbon‑carbon double bond (“C‑C double bonds”). This satisfies the tool’s requirement for at least one list‑type criterion.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_broken": null,
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
